title: Add INKRUSH to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [INKRUSH](https://inkrush-comic-studio.onrender.com) to image
- Free browser-based AI comic book maker powered by Pollinations.AI. Create multi-panel comic stories with custom speech bubbles, character lock, retro comic styles, and export as PDF books.📖

Fixes #13239

gist.headline: Comics enter the garden
gist.blurb: INKRUSH has sprouted in the app garden: a browser comic studio for turning ideas into multi-panel stories, speech bubbles and all. Polli brought a beret, naturally.
gist.summary: Added INKRUSH to the Pollinations app catalog: a free browser-based AI comic maker with multi-panel stories, custom speech bubbles, character locking, retro comic styles, and PDF book export.
gist.impact: People browsing Pollinations apps can now find INKRUSH and make consistent AI comic stories directly in the browser before exporting them as PDF books.
gist.visual_concept: Depict INKRUSH as a cozy retro comic-making desk: a multi-panel comic page on a CRT monitor, speech bubbles, ink pens, and a small stack of finished PDF comic books. Polli wears a tiny artist beret and carefully adds a speech bubble while a code-flower vine curls around the workstation, making the comic studio feel like a new plant in the app garden.
